annotations.title: Connect, or sign in by email

description: Sign in to Avokata with the user's email and language: free, one email, no password. Required for every tool except whoami and describe (shared 0.61.0). One email goes out with a Confirm link and a six-digit code; then call connect_verify(request_id) right away - it waits for the click.

email.description: The user's email: every tool except whoami and describe needs a signed-in account (free, one email). One message goes out with a Confirm link and a six-digit code; finish with `connect_verify`.
email.title: Email

firm.description: Optional, and never worth asking a user for: the firm or organisation, if it was already mentioned.
firm.title: Firm

language.description: The user's language for the sign-in email, as a tag (`lt`, `en`, `de`, `fr`, `es`, `pl`). Pass the language the user writes in; unknown tags fall back to English.
language.title: Language

name: connect
title: Connect, or sign in by email
